tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The poster paper every section sits on.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Boxes, forms, chat window and alternate section bands.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `paper` and `card` (17.1:1 on light paper, 16.6:1 on dark).

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, sub-heads and captions on `paper` and `card` (6.3:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every border and every hard offset shadow. Always solid, never tinted.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Action and urgency: the main button, the live counter, the member card, key words in headlines. `on-red` text on it is exactly 4.5:1, so keep that text 19px bold or larger. Red text on `paper` is 4.0:1 light and 4.2:1 dark, so red type is for 24px+ headlines only.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Highlight: the tilted `mark` behind one or two words, the scam-alert band, referral tags, the chat header. Text on it is always `on-yellow`.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Fixed black for bands that stay dark in both themes (the pledge and hiring sections, the slogan ticker).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Fixed off-white for copy on `black` bands in both themes (17.1:1).

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `red` fills (4.5:1, the minimum). Keep to 19px bold or larger.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `yellow` fills (13.8:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 4px solid with a 3px offset. Strong on dark paper (13.4:1), black bands (13.8:1) and red (3.2:1). On light `paper` it is only 1.2:1, so the live site's focus ring is hard to see there: known gap, fix by switching to `ink` on light grounds.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page. Uppercase. Scales down to 58px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headlines. Uppercase, two short lines at most.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: Live numbers: member count, member number. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We add you to the right group and send your invite on WhatsApp.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Your invite is on its way.
styles.usage: Chat bubbles, list items, form feedback.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Eyebrow label above a headline, set in a solid `ink` box. Uppercase.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Never pay anyone for a job.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip and chat-bubble gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Box padding; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between the two columns of a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every section.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, boxes, inputs, cards. Koottam is square.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only the blinking live dot and the launcher's notification dot.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and job rows. Grows to 8px on hover, drops to 2px on press.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Boxes, cards and the chat window.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: The hero counter only.

tokens.name: stroke-thick
tokens.usage: Borders on boxes, buttons, inputs and section dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-mid
tokens.usage: Chips, chat bubbles, small inputs.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Tags and leaderboard row dividers.

tokens.name: tilt-mark
tokens.usage: The yellow highlight behind a word.

tokens.name: tilt-stamp
tokens.usage: The red outline stamp above the hero.

tokens.name: tilt-counter
tokens.usage: The hero counter box.
